title: 标签
review: couldfile_review20260814.md 二、核心功能设计·标签 / 四、权限与标签模型
comment: Executable form of the review checklist `couldfile_review20260814.md` for this module. channel: `api` = assertable over HTTP by tests/e2e/review_<module>_matrix.py; channel: `ui` = browser-only, reported as skipped by the API matrix and deferred to a future browser suite. perm is the CE permission level the principal exercises (r / rw / admin / none / n/a); the five-level role model is NOT adopted (see docs/roles-semantics.md), so role-level cases are absent by design.

cases.name: tags bind uniformly to files and folders
cases.review: 文件与文件夹统一支持标签
cases.expect: the same tag can attach to both a file and a folder and round-trips

cases.name: system tags are read-only for non-admin
cases.expect: a non-admin cannot create/delete/rename a system tag (403)

cases.name: user tags are editable with rw permission
cases.expect: a rw user can create/delete/rename their own user tags

cases.name: user tags are not editable with r permission
cases.expect: a r user cannot create/delete/rename user tags (403)

cases.name: batch add tag respects the object limit
cases.review: 支持批量加标签（建议单次对象上限）
cases.expect: batch tagging beyond the configured limit is rejected or chunked

cases.name: system tag shows a lock icon
cases.expect: system tags render with a lock icon, user tags do not

cases.name: tags ordered user-tags then system-tags
cases.review: 展示顺序为用户标签→系统标签
cases.expect: user tags render before system tags

cases.name: three or more tags fold to two plus ellipsis
cases.review: 三个及以上展示前两个和…
cases.expect: three or more tags render as the first two plus an ellipsis

cases.name: clicking a tag does not pop the related-file list
cases.review: 点击标签仅选中或展示信息，不再直接弹关联文件列表
cases.expect: clicking a tag does not open a related-file list popup
